podcast.subtitle: Voices, sounds and stories from the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana. Interviews, live electronics, Erasmus experiences and festival partners.
podcast.whoPara1: CiSiamo is the podcast of the Student Association of the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana. Each episode explores a facet of musical, cultural and academic life at the Conservatory.
podcast.whoPara2: Interviews with artists and faculty, festival reportages, in-depth looks at disciplines, and stories from those who live music every day.

ramificazioni.label: ASSUML Co-production · 2025 / 2026
ramificazioni.heroPara1: A platform for contemporary music, electroacoustics and sonic arts. Born from the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana, open to the world.
ramificazioni.heroPara2: Concerts, sound installations, workshops and talks across various Lugano venues. International artists, Conservatory students and collaborations with partner institutions.
ramificazioni.manifesto1: Ramificazioni was born from the need to create a space where new music can breathe, expand and cross-pollinate. A festival that does not separate composition from performance, process from result, research from communication.
ramificazioni.manifesto2: Each edition is a map of connections: between languages, generations, places. Ticino as Europe's sonic crossroads.

events.desc: Inaugural evenings with Conservatory ensembles, soloists and international guest artists.
Site-specific works spread across various city spaces, freely accessible to the public.
Open composition and improvisation sessions with resident artists.
Conversations with composers, sound engineers and researchers on the future of music.
